subject.title: fix(sandbox): preserve active work during Docker config rollout

question: After the direct cancellation leak is fixed, does the sandbox security owner approve the process-local lease coordinator and authenticated browser retry as the intended lifecycle boundary?
rationale: The patch controls destructive sandbox replacement and retries authenticated browser requests across container replacement; CODEOWNERS and the PR body explicitly require owner judgment for that boundary.

options.title: Approve after focused repair
options.body: Accept the coordinator and retry design after the direct Codex abort signal and deterministic regression proof are added.

options.title: Require broader redesign
options.body: Request a different lifecycle ownership model if process-local coordination is not sufficient for the sandbox security boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after focused repair
recommendation.body: Accept the coordinator and retry design after the direct Codex abort signal and deterministic regression proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the sandbox implementation and documentation paths in CODEOWNERS.
